notes.title: Bug Fix.
notes.notes:
Sorry. Yesterday, I had a bug where the player's save disappeared as the wrong file was distributed. I fixed that part.

If the save file has already been damaged, please follow the following process.
1. Go to C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Temporis Arts\save\ (or game installation folder\save\)
2. Replace the MusicTemporis.dat file with the latest and largest file numbered MusicTemporis00.dat.
2-1. Do not use MusicTemporis10.dat at this time.
3. If you still have problems, try using older files more and more.

If it doesn't work out well, please contact me through the Discord channel, thank you.

notes.title: Temporis Arts UI Update Done!
notes.notes:
The 3rd UI update has been carried out!

- UI
Overhauled UI and font in play.
Modified the policy when you pressed ESC during play.
You have completely rewritten the resulting window production.
BGM has been added to the results window.
At the top of the song slider of the selection window, the ability to change up and down the sorting order has been added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697830/7ffd86ebb82c490dbfaa66dea25a7a6649c405da.png[/img]

- In-game settings
I created an in-game setup page, including changing the color of the note.
Combo positioning can be specified, and the visibility of the combo that appears in the note position has been improved in particular.
The way Fast/Slow settings are implemented will be changed. (ms output is no longer available...)
You can now draw a connection line at the same time.
You can now put a sign when there is a shift, and you can choose how much shift you want to mark.

- Pattern
 The Glimmer EX (15)

- Other
The song jacket for 1109 has been changed. This is the illustration you're looking at now!
 The entry limit level for "Chronos Altar" has been raised to 30.


That's the end of the first large UI update I planned this time!
Updates such as new songs, Shin Hae-geum, and challenging elements will continue. We look forward to your continued support.

notes.notes:
I stop posting the game for a very personal reason for a certain period of time, as some propagated through separate channels.

If you're in the library, you can still download, play, and access the community.
It's something that's not only searched on the store page.

However, patches become impossible and not exposed, so if the period is prolonged, We will not be able to participate in the rhythm game festival.

[b]The situation is expected to end no later than this year. [/b]
